task.goal: Add CSV export for the currently filtered results table.
task.context: The table already supports filtering and column selection.
task.requirements: R1: Export only rows matching the active filters. R2: Preserve the visible column order. R3: Preserve existing filtering and sorting behavior.
task.acceptance: A1: Compare exported rows with the filtered table; they match. Covers R1. A2: Compare CSV headers with visible columns; order matches. Covers R2. A3: Verify existing filtering and sorting still work. Covers R3.
task.permissions: Authorized: local implementation and focused verification. Not authorized: deployment or unrelated changes.
task.deliverable: Working local change and a brief account of verification and remaining limits.
